# proxy-usage-analysis: consume actor/source/reason attribution from proxy restart logs

## Goal

Teach the proxy-usage-analysis tooling to consume the attribution markers added
by **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** (actor/source/reason on mode-switch and `--restart`
log lines) so restart attribution appears in the generated reports and the
mode-timeline classification stops being heuristic.

## Context

**LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** adds structured attribution to the proxy logs
(`source=scheduler|worker|api|manual`, `actor`, `reason`, requested `mode`) at
`set_mode()` time and to `start-proxy.sh --restart` startup output. Its AC3
proves attribution with a reproducible grep only; the reporting/parsing stack
(`.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/log_parser.py`, `bucketing.py`,
`reporting.py`) and `scripts/analyze_mode_flips.py` still classify restart
causes heuristically.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `log_parser.py` parses the new attribution markers into structured fields
      on the restart/mode-switch events (absent markers degrade gracefully to
      the current behaviour).
- [ ] `bucketing.py` / `reporting.py` surface the attribution (source + actor +
      reason) in the mode-timeline / restart report sections.
- [ ] `scripts/analyze_mode_flips.py` uses `source` to classify flips instead of
      heuristics where the marker is present.
- [ ] Unit tests cover parsing of the new markers (present + absent) and the
      report output.
- [ ] A report generated from logs containing the new markers shows zero
      "unknown/ unattributable" restarts that carry a marker.
- [ ] All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including
      code comments, README, and any relevant docs site entries.
- [ ] Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- Depends on **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** landing first (markers must exist).
- Backward compatible: must still parse historical logs without the markers.

## Related work

- **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** — Log the requesting actor and reason for every proxy
  mode-switch / `--restart` so restarts are always attributable
  (`discovered-from`).
- **LP-0MT1EE315007AKXG** — proxy-usage-analysis: recognise manual mode switches
  in the mode timeline.
data.title: proxy-usage-analysis: consume actor/source/reason attribution from proxy restart logs

# Parse attribution markers in log_parser.py

## Goal

Teach `log_parser.py` to parse the actor/source attribution markers
added by **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** into structured fields on restart and
mode-switch LogEvents, degrading gracefully when markers are absent.

## Scope

- Add two new fields to `LogEvent`: `source` (str | None) and `actor`
  (str | None). The existing `reason` field is reused to carry the
  attribution `reason=` value on restart/mode-switch events (it is
  currently always `None` for these kinds, so reuse is backward compatible).
- Parse `source=scheduler|worker|api|manual` from:
  - `Mode-switch restart spawned:` lines (attribution appended at
    `set_mode()` time)
  - Mode-switch lines (`Mode scheduler: applied scheduled mode ...` and
    `Grandfathering: enabled; ...`)
  - The `start-proxy.sh --restart` startup attribution line (reason echoed
    into the new process startup log before the `Starting LLama Proxy Server`
    marker)
- Parse `actor=<name>` and `reason=<text>` from the same lines.
- When markers are absent, the fields remain `None` (existing behaviour
  preserved).
- Add tolerant regex extractors (`source=`, `actor=`, `reason=`) so any
  future key=value attribution fields are easy to add.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `log_parser.py` parses the new attribution markers into structured
      fields on the restart/mode-switch events (absent markers degrade
      gracefully to the current behaviour).
- [ ] `LogEvent.source` / `LogEvent.actor` are populated and `LogEvent.reason`
      carries the attribution reason when markers are present on restart and
      mode-switch lines.
- [ ] When markers are absent, the new fields default to `None` (backward
      compatible; existing tests unchanged).
- [ ] A tolerant regex pattern extracts `source=`, `actor=`, and `reason=`
      from arbitrary log lines.
- [ ] Unit tests cover: markers present on spawned/complete/startup lines,
      markers absent (historical log), missing individual keys.
- [ ] No regression in existing log-line parsing (all existing tests still pass).

## Key Files

- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/log_parser.py`
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py`

## Dependencies

- **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** — the attribution markers must be produced by
  the proxy first; verify the exact landed marker format before finalising
  the extractors.
data.title: Parse attribution markers in log_parser.py

# Surface attribution in reporting.py

## Goal

Surface the source/actor/reason attribution in the generated reports so
restart and mode-switch causes are deterministic instead of heuristic.

## Scope

- Extend `aggregation.py` to collect restart/mode-switch events that carry
  attribution (currently only timestamps are collected: `mode_transitions`
  and `restart_signals`) so the report can render them.
- Update `reporting.py` to render the attribution in a restart/mode-timeline
  report section: one row per restart/mode-switch event with source, actor,
  reason, requested mode, and timestamp.
- When attribution is present, classify/display from the markers; when
  absent, fall back to the existing heuristic display.
- Source values are displayed consistently: `scheduler`, `worker`, `api`,
  `manual`.
- `bucketing.py` changes are only required if the mode timeline
  (`ModeScheduleMap.transitions`) must carry attribution for the report —
  a small optional extension; the primary surface is the new report section.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `bucketing.py` / `reporting.py` surface the attribution (source + actor +
      reason) in the mode-timeline / restart report sections.
- [ ] A report section lists restart/mode-switch events with source, actor,
      reason, and requested mode when attribution is present in the logs.
- [ ] Restarts without markers fall back to the existing heuristic
      classification (backward compatible).
- [ ] Source values render as `scheduler`, `worker`, `api`, `manual`.
- [ ] A report generated from logs containing the new markers shows zero
      "unknown/unattributable" restarts that carry a marker.
- [ ] Unit tests cover report output with and without attribution markers.
- [ ] No regression in existing report output.

## Key Files

- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/reporting.py`
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/aggregation.py`
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/bucketing.py` (optional)
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py`

## Dependencies

- **LP-0MVC0S6U5003SEDJ** — attribution markers must be parsed in log_parser.py first

# Use source attribution in analyze_mode_flips.py

## Goal

Replace the heuristic classification of mode-flip triggers in `analyze_mode_flips.py` with deterministic attribution from the `source` field when available.

## Scope

- Update `classify_trigger()` to use the `source` field from restart events when present.
- Map `source=worker` to `to-cheap` (the ContextHub worker's behaviour).
- Map `source=scheduler` to `schedule`.
- Map `source=api` and `source=manual` to their respective categories.
- Fall back to the existing heuristic classification when `source` is absent.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `scripts/analyze_mode_flips.py` uses `source` to classify flips instead of heuristics where the marker is present.
- [ ] `classify_trigger()` uses `source` field when present, matching expected categories (`scheduler` → `schedule`, `worker`/`api`/`manual` → `to-fast`/`to-cheap` by mode where the marker is present).
- [ ] Fallback to heuristic when attribution is absent (backward compatible).
- [ ] Unit tests cover: all source values present, source absent (heuristic fallback).
- [ ] No regression in existing analyze_mode_flips.py tests.

## Key Files

- `scripts/analyze_mode_flips.py`
- `tests/test_mode_flip_analysis.py`

## Dependencies

- **LP-0MVC0S6U5003SEDJ** — attribution markers must be parsed in log_parser.py first

# Unit tests: attribution marker parsing and report output

## Goal

Comprehensive unit tests covering all attribution marker scenarios (present
and absent) for parsing, classification, and report output — satisfying
parent AC4 (unit tests) and AC5 (zero unattributable restarts carrying a
marker).

## Scope

- Tests for `log_parser.py`:
  - Parsing attribution markers present on `Mode-switch restart spawned`
    lines, `restart` startup lines, and mode-switch lines
  - Parsing lines without markers (degrades gracefully to `None` fields)
  - Edge cases: missing source/actor/reason keys individually
- Tests for the report:
  - Report output with full attribution (source/actor/reason visible)
  - Report output without attribution (heuristic fallback)
  - Zero unknown/unattributable restarts when every marker-carrying restart
    is attributed
- Tests for `analyze_mode_flips.py`:
  - Classification with source present (scheduler/worker/api/manual)
  - Classification with source absent (heuristic fallback)
  - Edge cases: unknown source values

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests cover parsing of the new markers (present + absent) and the report output.
- [ ] Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.
- [ ] All new marker parsing paths are covered by unit tests.
- [ ] Backward-compatibility tests (historical logs without markers) pass.
- [ ] Report-output assertions verify source/actor/reason appear in the
      markdown when present.
- [ ] `analyze_mode_flips.py` classification tests cover all source values
      plus the heuristic fallback.
- [ ] A fixture log containing markers yields zero "unknown/unattributable"
      restarts in the report (parent AC5).

## Key Files

- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py`
- `tests/test_mode_flip_analysis.py`
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/fixtures.py` (marker fixtures)

## Dependencies

- **LP-0MVC0S6U5003SEDJ** (log_parser) — parsing must be implemented first
- **LP-0MVC144KS001PDR4** (reporting) — report surface must be implemented first
- **LP-0MVC1450O000LJHV** (mode_flips) — classification must be implemented first
